attempts.rationale: The subject is added as an admin collaborator on a private repo, so their first read succeeds. In world A, permission is evaluated fresh per request; after the owner revokes the subject, the second read re-evaluates to no role and returns 404. In world A+B, B's per-session role cache remembers the subject's admin role from the first read, so the second read still succeeds (200), violating the expected 404 and causing the probe to fail. If A's revoke did nothing, the second read would also return 200 and fail. In base and B the revoke route does not exist, so the DELETE receives Hono's default 404 text/plain and the probe reports n/a.
